devdoc.details: Every output goes to the recorded beneficiary; callers can only execute a due slice. No promise of execution: a funded caller must submit each transaction and minimum price may block it.

configure(uint256,uint128,bool).notice: Only the creating wallet/NFT account may change its price floor or pause.

withdrawReward(address).notice: Pull payments prevent a reverting keeper from blocking the schedule.
